children: MillerKnoll posted first-quarter fiscal 2027 results for the period ended August 29, 2026, reporting net sales of $923.4 million and net earnings attributable to MillerKnoll of $26.6 million. Adjusted diluted earnings per share were $0.53 (GAAP diluted EPS $0.38) and adjusted operating margin expanded to 7.1% versus 6.3% a year earlier. The quarter included an approximate $10 million net benefit from U.S. tariff refunds, which added roughly $0.11 to diluted EPS and about 110 basis points to operating margin.
Revenue (Net sales): $923.4 million for the three months ended August 29, 2026 (down 3.4% year‑over‑year).
Gross profit: $385.3 million; gross margin 41.7% (up from 38.5% in prior year).
Operating income: $51.8 million; operating margin 5.6% (unchanged year‑over‑year).
Net earnings attributable to MillerKnoll: $26.6 million for the quarter.
Adjusted diluted earnings per share: $0.53; Diluted EPS (GAAP): $0.38.
Tariff refund impact: Recognized approximately $10 million net related to U.S. IEEPA tariff refunds, improving operating margin by ~110 basis points and adding ~$0.11 per diluted share.

Segment performance: North America Contract sales declined ~5.3% with operating margin of 9.4%; International Contract sales declined ~6.4% with operating margin of 2.4%; Global Retail sales increased 2.6% with operating margin of 6.1%.
Orders: Consolidated orders were $913.9 million, up 3.2% reported and up 3.5% organically year‑over‑year, with International Contract and Global Retail showing order growth.

Retail footprint expansion: Opened four retail locations in Q1 including a DWR store in Raleigh and Herman Miller stores in Columbus, St. Louis and San Antonio; total retail locations increased to 97.

Cost actions and restructurings: Recorded $13.4 million of operating expense special charges comprising targeted workforce reductions and facility consolidations, purchase accounting amortization and CEO transition costs as part of focused cost management efforts.
